# Aggregation functions

57 of 59 supported. Used in `summarize`, `make-series` and `top-nested`.
Descriptions are the first sentence of each entry's page in Microsoft's [KQL documentation](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/) (CC BY 4.0); the names link there. "gokql" says whether this engine accepts the entry, probed from the code; Notes are gokql's own.

### Aggregation functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [any()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/take-any-aggregation-function) | yes | Arbitrarily chooses one record for each group in a summarize operator, and returns the value of one or more expressions over each such record. |  |
| [anyif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/take-anyif-aggregation-function) | yes | Arbitrarily selects one record for each group in a summarize operator in records for which the predicate is 'true'. |  |
| [argmax()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/arg-max-aggregation-function) | **no** | Finds a row in the table that maximizes the specified expression. | Deprecated name of arg_max with older column naming (max_x, max_x_y); not accepted here. Use arg_max(). |
| [argmin()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/arg-min-aggregation-function) | **no** | Finds a row in the table that minimizes the specified expression. | Deprecated name of arg_min; not accepted here. Use arg_min(). |
| [cnt()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/count-aggregation-function) | yes | Counts the number of records per summarization group, or total if summarization is done without grouping. |  |
| [count()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/count-aggregation-function) | yes | Counts the number of records per summarization group, or total if summarization is done without grouping. |  |
| [count_distinct()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/count-distinct-aggregation-function) | yes | Counts unique values specified by the scalar expression per summary group, or the total number of unique values if the summary group is omitted. |  |
| [count_distinctif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/count-distinctif-aggregation-function) | yes | Conditionally counts unique values specified by the scalar expression per summary group, or the total number of unique values if the summary group is omitted. |  |
| [countif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/countif-aggregation-function) | yes | Counts the rows in which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [covariance()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/covariance-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2. |  |
| [covarianceif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/covarianceif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2 in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [covariancep()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/covariancep-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the population covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2. |  |
| [covariancepif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/covariancepif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the sample covariance of two random variables expr1 and expr2 in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [dcount()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/dcount-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates an estimate of the number of distinct values that are taken by a scalar expression in the summary group. |  |
| [dcountif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/dcountif-aggregation-function) | yes | Estimates the number of distinct values of expr for rows in which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [make_bag()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-bag-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` JSON property bag (dictionary) of all the values of expr in the group. |  |
| [make_bag_if()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-bag-if-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` JSON property bag (dictionary) of expr values in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [make_list()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-list-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of all the values of expr in the group. |  |
| [make_list_if()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-list-if-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of expr values in the group for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [make_set()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-set-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in the group. |  |
| [make_set_if()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-set-if-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [makelist()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-list-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of all the values of expr in the group. |  |
| [makeset()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-set-aggregation-function) | yes | Creates a `dynamic` array of the set of distinct values that expr takes in the group. |  |
| [max()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/max-aggregation-function) | yes | Finds the maximum value of the expression in the table. |  |
| [maxif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/maxif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the maximum value of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [merge_tdigest()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/tdigest-merge-aggregation-function) | yes | Merges tdigest results across the group. |  |
| [min()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/min-aggregation-function) | yes | Finds the minimum value of the expression in the table. |  |
| [minif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/minif-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the minimum of Expr in records for which Predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [percentilew()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentilesw-aggregation-function) | yes | The `percentilew()` function calculates a weighted estimate for the specified nearest-rank percentile of the population defined by expr. |  |
| [stdev()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/stdev-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the standard deviation of expr across the group, using Bessel's correction for a small dataset that is considered a sample. |  |
| [stdevif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/stdevif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the standard deviation of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [sum()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/sum-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the sum of expr across the group. |  |
| [sumif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/sumif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the sum of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [take_any()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/take-any-aggregation-function) | yes | Arbitrarily chooses one record for each group in a summarize operator, and returns the value of one or more expressions over each such record. |  |
| [take_anyif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/take-anyif-aggregation-function) | yes | Arbitrarily selects one record for each group in a summarize operator in records for which the predicate is 'true'. |  |
| [variance()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/variance-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the variance of expr across the group, considering the group as a sample. |  |
| [varianceif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/varianceif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the variance of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |
| [variancep()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/variancep-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the variance of expr across the group, considering the group as a population. |  |
| [variancepif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/variancepif-aggregation-function) | yes | Calculates the variance of expr in records for which predicate evaluates to `true`. |  |

### Binary functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [binary_all_and()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/binary-all-and-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns aggregated value using the binary AND of the group. |  |
| [binary_all_or()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/binary-all-or-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns aggregated value using the binary OR of the group. |  |
| [binary_all_xor()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/binary-all-xor-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns aggregated value using the binary XOR of the group. |  |

### Dynamic functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [buildschema()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/buildschema-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the minimal schema that admits all values of the dynamic input. |  |
| [make_list_with_nulls()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/make-list-with-nulls-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns a list of all the values within the group, including null values. |  |

### Row selector functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [arg_max()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/arg-max-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns one or more expressions when the argument is maximized. |  |
| [arg_min()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/arg-min-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns one or more expressions when the argument is minimized. |  |

### Statistical functions

| Name | gokql | Description | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| [avg()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/avg-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns an average value across the group. |  |
| [avgif()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/avgif-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns an average value across the group (with predicate). |  |
| [hll()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/hll-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the HyperLogLog (HLL) results of the group elements, an intermediate value of the `dcount` approximation. | The sketch encoding is gokql's own: dcount_hll and hll_merge agree within the estimate, but a sketch from ADX cannot be merged here. |
| [hll_if()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/hll-if-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the HyperLogLog (HLL) results of the group elements, an intermediate value of the `dcount` approximation (with predicate). |  |
| [hll_merge()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/hll-merge-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns a value for merged HLL results. |  |
| [percentile()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentiles-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns a percentile estimation of the group. | Nearest-rank, as ADX: exact on small inputs; on large inputs ADX's t-digest can differ in the last digits. |
| [percentiles()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentiles-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns percentile estimations of the group. | As percentile(). |
| [percentiles_array()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentiles-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the percentile approximates of the array. |  |
| [percentilesw()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentilesw-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the weighted percentile approximate of the group. |  |
| [percentilesw_array()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/percentilesw-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the weighted percentile approximate of the array. |  |
| [stdevp()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/stdevp-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the standard deviation across the group for a population that is considered representative. |  |
| [tdigest()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/tdigest-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns an intermediate result for the percentiles approximation, the weighted percentile approximate of the group. | The digest encoding is gokql's own; percentile_tdigest results agree within the digest's accuracy. |
| [tdigest_merge()](https://learn.microsoft.com/kusto/query/tdigest-merge-aggregation-function) | yes | Returns the merged `tdigest` value across the group. |  |
